text: 中国政法大学教授刘纪鹏发文指出，大多数投资者赔钱，直接影响信心和消费。上证指数去年10月见到4000点，从4月7日的3040点涨了960点到10月，现在9个月过去了，又从4000点往回退。中国历史上重复好几次了——牛市牛不过一年。第三次冲破4000点，能不能长久、能不能克服“牛短熊长”的局面，取决于制度变化。 刘纪鹏指出，这次是国家拉动的股市。国家队平准基金的使命，就是在股市困难时肩负起重任。但肩负使命，不能低吸高抛，不能与民争利——要透明。股市上的人民性就是要建一个好的股市，让大家都能挣到钱——起码大多数人能挣到钱，这在理论上应该是成立的。你不能把股市
text_en: Liu Jipeng, professor at China University of Political Science and Law, notes that most investors losing money directly impacts confidence and consumption. The Shanghai Composite Index hit 4,000 in October last year after rising 960 points from 3,040 on April 7, but has retreated from 4,000 over the past nine months. This pattern has repeated several times in China's history—bull markets rarely last more than a year. Whether the third breakout above 4,000 can be sustained and overcome the "short bull, long bear" dynamic depends on institutional changes. Liu points out this is a state-driven market rally. The national team's stabilization fund mission is to shoulder responsibility during market difficulties, but it must not buy low and sell high or compete with the public for profits—transparency is key. The people-centered nature of the stock market means building a good market where most can profit, which should hold theoretically. You cannot turn the stock market...
